findings.text: merge candidate conflict: 750b10b in bundlebees_plugin/acdd_cli.py, bundlebees_plugin/sandbox.py; built without it

Parallel dispatch through Orbit is impossible from bundlebees: OrbitAdapterClient sends no task_id (only kanban_task_id), Orbit keys attempts by task_id, so every task-less attempt shares task_id=undefined and each new dispatch supersedes and cancels the previous active one (here ['A1']). Owners: bundlebees #9 client + Orbit #28 create.
